Walmart's Enterprise Business Services (EBS) is a powerhouse of several exceptional teams delivering world-class technology solutions and services making a profound impact at every level of Walmart. As a key part of Walmart Global Tech, our teams set the bar for operational excellence and leverage emerging technology to support millions of customers, associates, and stakeholders worldwide. Each time an associate turns on their laptop, a customer makes a purchase, a new supplier is onboarded, the company closes the books, physical and legal risk is avoided, and when we pay our associates consistently and accurately, that is EBS. Joining EBS means embarking on a journey of limitless growth, relentless innovation, and the chance to set new industry standards that shape the future of Walmart. Team is looking for a strong Senior Software Engineer(Full stack) who will drive building next generation Walmart suite of products and platform by designing, coding, building and deploying highly scalable and robust cloud based solutions. The role is expected to make a difference to the products in terms of the design and contribute towards identifying technical risks and find alternate solutions to various problems. In addition to that, the role also demands to lead, motivate, mentor and provide ample guidance to the other team members with respect to technical challenges. As a part of Enterprise Business Services Bangalore team in India that works on building solutions various business functions for multiple Walmart markets, your design and solution will have a significant impact on day-to-day running of Walmart. You will be challenged with unparalleled complex business problems that spans across multiple countries, large number of users and data. What you will do You will work with the team and help them on technical aspects, set quality standards and participate in design discussion and drive technical decisions Architecture/Design Reviews within the team and across the teams Code Reviews within the team and across the teams Engage with Product Management and Business to drive the agenda, set your priorities and deliver awesome products. Drive design, development, implementation and documentation Build, test and deploy cutting edge solutions at scale, impacting associates of Walmart worldwide. Interact with Walmart engineering teams across geographies to leverage expertise and contribute to the tech community. Drive the success of the implementation by applying technical skills, to design and build enhanced processes and technical solutions in support of strategic initiatives. You will use your engineering experience and technical skill to develop highly scalable and robust solutions. You will work with Engineering Lead/architect. Work closely with the Architects and cross functional teams and follow established practices for the delivery of solutions meeting QCD (Quality, Cost ; Delivery). Within the established architectural guidelines. Work with senior leadership to chart out the future roadmap of the products Participate in hiring and build teams enabling them to be high performing agile teams. Interact closely for requirements with Business owners and technical teams both within India and across the globe. What you'll bring: Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field required. Excellent team player with a passion for collaboration and innovation. 7+ years of object-oriented software development experience using React JS, Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Docker, Microservices, SQL & NoSQL databases. Strong experience in designing, developing, and deploying scalable Java-based applications and microservices. Expertise in event-driven programming, preferably with Kafka. Hands-on experience with testing frameworks and tools like JUnit, Mockito, Maven/Gradle, Jenkins, and Git. Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, OpenObserve, Prometheus, and Grafana. Exposure to AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot. Basic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Python and Agentic AI concepts. Expertise in cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Experience with frontend integration using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Deep understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and System Design principles. Experience developing highly scalable and available enterprise-grade products. Hands-on experience working in Agile development environments. Strong knowledge of application security concepts (authentication, authorization, encryption, etc.) and enterprise security best practices. Open to learning and adopting new technologies as per project requirements. About Walmart Global Tech Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. Thats what we do at Walmart Global Tech. Were a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the worlds leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. Benefits Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. Belonging We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is and feels included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, were able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. Equal Opportunity Employer: Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting, and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being welcoming of all people. Minimum Qualifications...Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications. Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years’ experience in software engineering or related area. Option 2: 5 years’ experience in software engineering or related area. Preferred Qualifications...Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications. Master’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, or related area and 1 year’s experience leading information security or cybersecurity projects, We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart’s accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture. About PyjamaHR - PyjamaHR is an applicant tracking system used by 600+ paying companies to run their hiring. Around the ATS it runs an AI voice interviewer that has conducted more than 65,000 live interviews since 2024, over 3,000 a month, a candidate database of tens of millions of Indian profiles now rolling out, and integrations with LinkedIn, Monster, ZipRecruiter and other job boards. The engineering team is deliberately small: a lead engineer, the founder, and this hire. How engineering works here - This is an AI-native engineering team in practice, not as a slogan. Every engineer works inside Claude Code or Codex all day. A typical unit of work starts with a live problem (a support ticket, a failed interview, a recruiter's screenshot), moves to a root cause proven with production evidence (logs, database, email provider), and ends as a small, well-described pull request. Pull requests are reviewed by several AI models and then by a human who re-derives the reasoning. Descriptions read like incident reports: what happened, why, what changed, how it was verified. There is no ticket queue between you and production. The bar is speed with verification, not speed alone. What you will work on - Real examples from the last few weeks, not a wish list: - Production engineering on the ATS (Python, Django, Celery, Postgres, React): asynchronous task chains that failed silently, email queues that dropped mail, resume parsing that lost files on large batches, LinkedIn profile URLs extracted wrongly from PDFs, job-board feeds with years-old defects. - The AI interviewer (Python LiveKit agent, Next.js, AWS Transcribe and Polly): speech-to-text reliability, interview-ending logic, caption delivery, cost per interview. - New surfaces moving from prototype to product: the candidate database (Next.js, OpenSearch), redesigned career pages, an internal leads app. Hardening means tests, feature flags, error states and monitoring. - The billing rebuild: Razorpay subscriptions and UPI Autopay, job-credit metering replacing the current plan model, migration of thousands of legacy and lifetime-deal accounts, with old and new billing running side by side. - Infrastructure: moving off a legacy AWS footprint to leaner infrastructure, database retention, cost. You own tickets end to end: reproduce, fix, test, ship, watch it in production. Who this is for - - 0–5 years of professional experience. Exceptional freshers are welcome and compete on equal terms. - Python first. You have shipped Python that real users depended on (Django preferred; Celery and Postgres a plus). Comfortable in React; TypeScript is a plus. - Genuinely AI-native. You work inside an agentic coding tool every day, and you have built something with AI that made it do real multi-step work: an agent, a pipeline, an automation that replaced human hours, a system that runs without you. Using AI to write emails, build a portfolio site or fix bugs in a codebase is table stakes here, not an answer. The application asks for the specific thing you built. That answer decides whether we talk. - You verify. You know when a model is confidently wrong and you have habits for catching it: tests, reading the diff, checking production data before claiming a fix. - Clear communication. You can explain a bug in five sentences, write a pull request description someone else can act on, and disagree with a senior engineer with reasons. Working arrangement - - Bengaluru. In the Koramangala office for the first weeks while you ramp up, hybrid after that. - Reports to the Lead Engineer; works daily with the founder. - ₹12–24 LPA fixed, full-time. Process - 1. Application, about ten minutes, including a short written answer about what you have built with AI. 2. A 15-minute AI interview about your own work and how you think. No trivia, no live coding. 3. A conversation with the founder and the lead engineer. Decisions within a week of the final conversation.
